purpose: Candidate research only; no new benchmark tasks published by this catalog

license.note: Preserve applicable source headers, Apache LICENSE, applicable NOTICE, and modification attribution; third-party libraries/checkpoints/datasets may have different terms.

candidates.title: Residual add + ReLU
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16, TILE; signed inputs, zeros, near-zero values; same input shapes initially
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: BF16-quantized inputs; FP32 reference relu(a+b); freeze absolute/relative bounds after device baseline calibration
candidates.baseline_to_validate: ttnn.relu(ttnn.add(a,b)); compare supported fused activation path separately
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Two inputs fit current solve(a,b); fused baseline API must be inspected and run. Broadcast variants need separately validated shapes. Larger shapes also require solving the current stdout/JSON output-size limit.

candidates.title: GEMM shape and aspect-ratio suite
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16, TILE; finite signed values, cancellation, zeros; start multiples of 32
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: Reference on quantized inputs with FP32 accumulation; tolerance per K/fidelity; record max abs, max rel and normalized error
candidates.baseline_to_validate: ttnn.matmul default config; later tuned program-config baseline
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Current runner fits. Irregular dimensions, larger output volumes and optional output tensors need validation; existing 256 KiB stdout limit prevents indiscriminate large JSON tensors. Official report P150 13x10 results are not this P300c result.

candidates.title: Transpose / layout conversion
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16 initially; TILE -> TILE; later ROW_MAJOR as a distinct track
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: Exact equality of logical values after initial BF16 quantization; verify shape and poisoned padding exclusion
candidates.baseline_to_validate: ttnn.permute / ttnn.transpose from matching pinned API
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Use a unary input contract instead of supplying an unused b. Pinned permute source includes a Blackhole-specific padding branch; source presence does not imply all paths pass.

candidates.title: Row sum / mean reduction
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16, TILE; signed cancellation, all zeros, constant rows, padded width
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: Quantized inputs and FP32 reference; output keepdim fixed; size-dependent absolute/relative bounds with zero-safe checks
candidates.baseline_to_validate: ttnn.sum / ttnn.mean with explicit dim and keepdim
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Unary contract and scalar config needed for clean interface. Explicitly ignore implicit padded elements.

candidates.title: Numerically stable row softmax
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16, TILE; repeated maxima, positive/negative logits, range +/-100, padding poison
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: FP32 stable reference on quantized logits; per-element bounds plus row-sum/nonnegative checks; PCC only supplementary, not sole acceptance
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Pinned tests exercise 24x42 padding and extreme values; attention optimized path requires 4D input. Calibrate stricter task-specific bounds rather than reusing every upstream tolerance.

candidates.title: RMSNorm with scale / residual
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16; gamma BF16; epsilon explicit; TILE input, ROW_MAJOR/TILE scale as separate cases
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: FP32 reference with frozen epsilon; zero/near-zero rows; all-element error and normalized error; dtype/path-specific bounds
candidates.baseline_to_validate: ttnn.rms_norm with explicit weight, epsilon and optional residual
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Plain two-input x,gamma TILE version may fit solve(a,b), but residual adds third input and ROW_MAJOR scale needs generalized manifest. Do not claim sharded support for this host until tested.

candidates.title: LayerNorm with affine parameters
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16; explicit epsilon; biased variance; constant and low-variance rows
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: FP32 reference on quantized x/gamma/beta; allclose and normalized error; record numerical path/fidelity
candidates.baseline_to_validate: ttnn.layer_norm; pin Welford versus legacy path as separate baselines
candidates.compatibility_caveat: At least x,gamma,beta; add optional residual only later. Source contains path-specific accuracy checks; global OJ atol=0.015625 is not an adequate policy for every norm case.

candidates.title: Scaled dot-product attention prefill
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16 initially; causal and noncausal separate tasks; no dropout; finite Q/K/V
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: FP32 PyTorch SDPA reference with frozen mask/scale; per-element and normalized error; adversarial outliers; no PCC-only judge
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Needs >=3 input tensors, scalar configuration and larger-data transport. Pinned test helper hardcodes WormholeComputeKernelConfig in several paths; adapt using arch() and verify Blackhole, do not copy blindly.

candidates.title: SwiGLU / gated MLP model fragment
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: Synthetic BF16 inputs/weights; one device; no external checkpoint dependency
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: FP32 fragment reference using BF16-quantized inputs; explicitly define intermediate/output quantization; bounds calibrated for accumulated layers
candidates.baseline_to_validate: Simple TTNN matmul+silu+multiply+matmul sequence; optimized fragment baseline after extraction
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Needs 4 tensors, owned buffers and general manifest. Existing model contains Blackhole-related shape branches, but full model runtime/config and multi-chip assumptions must be removed for this isolated task.

candidates.title: DRAM -> L1 -> DRAM copy
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: Raw BF16 payload / arbitrary bit patterns; one core then multicore separate task
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: Byte-for-byte output buffer equality, no numeric tolerance
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Current RISC-V task host only moves two uint32 values. Needs trusted host buffers, runtime args and page-count template; use TensorAccessor, no hardcoded Wormhole bank count.

candidates.title: Multitile / multicore vector add
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16 TILE; nonconstant full tile data; uneven tile work partition
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: FP32 reference on BF16 inputs with declared BF16 output rounding; all elements and boundaries checked
candidates.baseline_to_validate: Single-core then official multicore vector-add baseline
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Existing TT2002 host only supplies uniform one-tile inputs. Needs tensor input and trusted reader/writer/work partition; cannot create by changing metadata alone.

candidates.title: SFPU exponential
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16 inputs range [-5,5]; output BF16; finite limits separate cases
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: FP32 exp reference on quantized inputs; relative plus absolute bounds, calibrated for documented math approximation mode
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Unary reader/writer and n_tiles args required; existing two-input single-tile compute host cannot be reused unchanged.

candidates.title: Custom SFPI smoothstep
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16 initially; explicit edge0<edge1, endpoints and values outside interval
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: FP32 reference on quantized inputs; range [0,1], endpoint checks and calibrated allclose
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Fixed SFPI 7.78.0 in runtime; add trusted unary host template and scalar args. Custom SFPI source-level compatibility is verified, no device execution in this research pass.

candidates.title: Metalium GEMM from single core to reuse/multicast
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16 TILE, exact prescribed fidelity initially; rectangular/multicore tracks later
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: FP32 matrix reference on quantized inputs; K/fidelity-specific error; verify every output tile
candidates.baseline_to_validate: Single-core, basic multicore, reuse, multicast variants under identical problem semantics
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Needs host construction plus custom reader/compute/writer or trusted template slots; current single kernel submission cannot express all design choices. Query actual grid and L1 from device API.

candidates.title: Softmax backward / training operator
candidates.dtype_and_edge_cases: BF16 probabilities and gradients initially; FP32 later; known forward output
candidates.correctness_policy_to_calibrate: Independent FP32 analytic reference plus selected finite-difference checks outside timed path; bounds per dtype/width
candidates.baseline_to_validate: TTNN composition first; native tt-train fused implementation after separately building runtime
candidates.compatibility_caveat: Two-input composition could fit existing solve(a,b), but native C++ tt-train cannot run in current kernel-only host, and current image does not establish tt-train availability. Pinned tests contain a P150-specific skip.
